surface: 岗位名称：用户体验设计师（AI 协同方向） 我们在做什么 我们正在打造下一代人机交互产品 —— 一套让人与机器人自然协作的智能终端体验。从网页到移动端，从控制台到完整生态，由设计组定义产品的视觉语言、交互规范和体验标准。 你会做什么 - 主导产品的交互与界面设计，从需求洞察到设计落地全流程 - 用 AI 编程工具把设计直接落成可上线的代码 - 维护和演进设计系统，统一产品的视觉与交互语言 我们要什么人 5 年以上 UI / 用户体验设计经验，C 端背景优先。 审美与视觉能力（核心） - 视觉敏锐度过硬：对版式、字体、色彩、留白、节奏有深入理解，能拿捏"克制"与"丰富"的边界 - 设计品味在线：作品集能看出对细节、质感、层次的追求，不靠装饰营造高级感 - 风格审美与当下一线工具型产品同频（Linear / Vercel / Notion / Arc 等），不沉迷过时的拟物或重质感装饰 交互与系统化能力 - 交互设计扎实：信息架构、状态、反馈、流程都拿得起 - 设计系统思维是默认配置：组件化、token 化、规范化的工作方式不是加分项，是基本盘 AI 协同能力（关键） - 重度 AI 工具使用者，离开 AI 会浑身难受 - 能熟练用 Claude Code / Cursor 等工具把设计落到代码里，独立产出可上线成果 - 持续关注 AI 工具的演进，对新模型、新工具有自己的尝试和判断 成长心态 - 对自己的成长有强烈要求，愿意持续学习与补课 - 把 AI 视为协作伙伴而非威胁；相信"懂设计 + 懂 AI"是未来设计师的护城河 加分项 - 在视觉设计 / 品牌设计 / 动效设计中至少有一项跨界能力 - 主导维护过完整的设计系统，且有可看的成果 - 作品被一线产品、媒体或设计社区收录、讨论过 投递方式 附 作品集 + 一个你做过的真实项目可访问链接（线上产品、可预览 Demo、可点开的页面均可）。这一项是关键门槛 —— 我们要看到的是落地到真实场景里的成果，不是概念稿。

surface: In this role you will build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers our robotics manipulation research. You'll work alongside our existing team of platform engineers to extend the systems that turn raw robot session data into curated, trainable episodes. This team owns streaming ingestion pipelines, platform and schema design, heterogeneous data sources, data curation and quality controls, full-stack inspection and dataset-builders that researchers and human annotators actually use, and tools to let scientists go from dataset to training job without leaving the platform. We run on a modern cloud-native stack — distributed compute on Kubernetes, streaming data infrastructure, columnar lakehouse storage, and a TypeScript/React frontend. We’re looking for engineers willing and eager to work on the full stack in a fast iteration cycle while working with researchers as close customers.

surface: Our Field Foundation Model (FFM) powers a global fleet of autonomous robots that capture massive streams of multimodal data across diverse, dynamic environments every day. Field-insight Foundation Model (FiFM) is at the core of how we transform multimodal data from autonomous robots into actionable insights. As an AI/ML Engineer on the FiFM team, you will drive research and model development for one of Field AI’s most ambitious initiatives. Your work will span computer vision, vision-language models (VLMs), multimodal scene understanding, and long-memory video analysis and search, with a strong emphasis on agentic AI (tool use, memory, multimodal retrieval-augmented generation).This is a full-cycle ML role: you’ll curate datasets, fine-tune and evaluate models, optimize inference, and deploy them into production. While FiFM is your primary focus, you’ll also contribute to broader perception and insight-generation initiatives across Field AI.
